fullData.title: Storm at Silver Lake
fullData.passage: Dark, dramatic clouds rolled heavily across the sky above Silver Lake. Suddenly, a bright bolt of lightning flashed and a loud boom echoed through the valley. The wind whispered through the tall pine trees, rustling their needles. Frogs began to croak loudly along the muddy shoreline. Splish, splash went the heavy raindrops hitting the surface of the water, creating tiny ripples everywhere.

instances.literalMeaning: Stormy clouds that look very serious and gloomy.
instances.explanation: The words 'Dark' and 'dramatic' start with the same 'D' sound.

instances.literalMeaning: A very loud noise caused by thunder.
instances.explanation: The word 'boom' imitates the actual sound of thunder.

instances.literalMeaning: The sound of rain hitting the water.
instances.explanation: The words 'Splish' and 'splash' imitate the sound of water splashing.
